requiredStates.wrapped/unwrapped views: present - the segmented Wrapped/Unwrapped control has Unwrapped active, while the inset is explicitly titled Wrapped view.
requiredStates.mapping/provenance trace: present - the inspector displays source through target and the canvas metadata states Source: current and Derived from Risset preset v2.

defects: Mathematical correctness fails: the displayed formula f(t) = sin(2pi * 2^(t/12) * t + phi3) does not produce a clean exponential octave progression. Its instantaneous frequency is proportional to 2^(t/12) * (1 + (ln 2)t/12): at t=12 it is 2(1+ln 2)=3.386 times the initial frequency, not 2 times; at t=24 it is 4(1+2ln 2)=9.545 times, not 4 times.

The plot calls the left-hand reset a continuous perceived ascent, but the selected cyan partial has a visible vertical jump from about +3 to about -3 at bar 45; the image supplies no continuous wrapped trajectory at that discontinuity.
The selected Layer 03 is mainly distinguished from the other partials by cyan; the canvas label helps, but the selection treatment itself has no robust non-colour pattern/shape counterpart.
No error, budget meter, predicted load, limit, or recovery state is shown; exact determinism is not an error/budget affordance.

strengths: The displayed exponential relation f(t) = f0 * 2^(t/T) is coherent with f0 = 220 Hz and T = 12.0 s: at t=12.0 s it gives 440 Hz, exactly one octave above 220 Hz.
The selected phase point links the polar canvas, Layer 3 clip, provenance target, and inspector, with a visible connector/link glyph and non-colour resize handles.

Material kinds have non-hue treatments: solid authored bed, dotted live-generated Layer 3, diagonal-hatched frozen snapshot, and a distinctly edged/linked derivative; the legend exposes those treatments.
Evidence has check, wrench, and lock glyphs; the experimental section has explicit text and a lock rather than colour alone.
The large direct-manipulation canvas, simple transport, and still-visible expert inspector make this the clearest novice-to-expert progression of the three.

screenNotes: All three visibly preserve the dark instrument shell, a working transport, material legend, mapping stages, evaluation evidence, a timeline, and a separated experimental area. All three omit a visible error/budget state and lack the non-pixel artifacts required by S8: accessibility annotation, described interaction behavior, and paired/written responsive behavior. A and B must be rejected for visible mathematical contradictions; C is the only variant without one found in the rendered values.
recommendationReason: C-spatial is the only variant that passes all three reject axes and its displayed exponential octave relation is numerically coherent. It still needs a clearly labelled rendered unwrapped view, explicit non-colour selection treatment, error/budget state, and S8 annotation/interaction/responsive handoff artifacts.
